text.text_excerpt: Came here with my auntie and had a nice time. We got there an hour after opening on a Sunday and we're waved in with no cover as it wasn't too crowded yet. However within an hour or so folks started coming in waves; mostly bachelorette parties, ladies nights out, and a few couples. Honestly was one of the most welcoming establishments. The guys were very personable and really worked the crowded even after they were done with their sets. Drink prices were average and we had a coupon for a free one. They attempted to cater to multiple tastes with black, white, Latino, and middle eastern performers spread among ages and build types. Music was on point and there was varying talent levels but ...

Let me tell you about THIS place! Sigh, it was literally the best I've ever been to. So my girls and I were on Bourbon Street for Mardi Gras week. This was the first day of our trip. As we're eating at Willies chicken shack that night, we looked across the street and saw a sign. Then we all looked at each other and smiled. Admission was $10. When we entered, we saw half naked men dancing and walking around. From the music, to the moves, to the great looking men, it was a FANTASTIC NIGHT! I would love love love love to go back there again. P.S. where ever on your body you place a dollar, they WILL go get it. So have your friends place them on you. You'll have a blast!

Let me tell you about a 4 day strip club extravaganza. The first night was my first time at a strip club, along with my friends. It was slow paced for a Thursday night which was a perfect introduction. The talent was amazing, we each got a lap dance from Aunders which was a perfect introduction to that aspect of the strip club experience. Friday night was a bit more fast paced with more male dancers, so more entertainment and more fun because there was a bigger crowd. I remember having a good time and when we left one of the dancers was hugging each patron and kissing their cheeks as he said thank you which I thought was truly sweet and made me and my friend want to come back even more.
